import sys

def main():
    input = sys.stdin.readline
    t = int(input())
    for _ in range(t):
        s = input().strip()
        n = len(s)
        str_result = ""
        str_result += s[0]
        flag = 0
        i = 1
        while i < n:
            if flag == 0 and i + 1 < n:
                s1 = s[i:i+2]
                if s1 == "at":
                    str_result += '@'
                    i += 2
                    flag += 1
                    continue
            if i + 2 < n:
                s1 = s[i:i+3]
                if s1 == "dot":
                    str_result += '.'
                    i += 3
                    continue
            str_result += s[i]
            i += 1
        print(str_result)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
